boardTitle: B168 and DT349: the recipe as written on top, fixed; Servings and Foods; What do you do with it? Plan it shows my portion

B168.title: The numbers under One portion show the whole recipe

opportunity.from: Seen while drawing B166, 23 November 2026, on Lazy Burek's page; Coach Milan 24 November 07:04: yes, its own ticket, we need to fix that.
opportunity.job: Read what one portion of my recipe holds.
opportunity.kind: Says something not true: the table under One portion shows the whole recipe.
opportunity.why_now: B166 made the table readable, so its numbers are now read.

B168.problem: On a recipe that makes 4 portions, the PD card says One portion, 549 kcal and 224 g. Its numbers say Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal, fat 135 g: the whole recipe. The Nutrition table below says 1 portion, 224 g. Two places on one page disagree about one portion.
B168.story: When I read a recipe's PD card and its numbers, I want them to say the same meal, so that I can trust what I plan and eat.
B168.now: The card says One portion, 549 kcal · 23.3 g protein · 224 g. Its numbers are handed the whole recipe: Total 897 g, 2,194 kcal. Cook it's − 4 portions + sits under the card and changes only the foods to cook.
B168.proposed: The top is the recipe as written and never moves: the PD card says The whole recipe, its rows 2,194 kcal, 897 g, 93 g, and its numbers Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal. One serving and 100 g stay in the Nutrition table, beside the whole recipe, fixed too. What changes with a choice is below the top (DT349). A serving is the recipe's equal share, the same for everyone; a portion is mine, calculated for a meal and my day (nutrition rule N17, Coach Milan 24 November 22:26).
B168.looked_at: The card at one portion (07:10): not chosen, 14:50: the header is the whole meal. − and + inside the card (07:55): not chosen, no more navigation in the card. The card following Cook it (08:05): not chosen; reading would change the batch. Numbers for above the card (14:00): not chosen, 14:49: the header is the meal; portioning goes somewhere else. Your portion on the recipe page (17:49 to 19:04): not in B168; a portion depends on the person, the meal and the day, so it comes when the reader picks a meal, DT351. The card following the count (25 November 07:54): not chosen, 07:58: the top is fixed, per full recipe as is. All 4 servings as the card's title (24 November): not chosen, it read like a selection next to Cook for. The whole recipe · makes 4 servings as the card's title (25 November 08:02): not chosen, 08:31: too much in the header, it breaks the card's template.
B168.short: The PD card and its numbers are the whole recipe, as written, fixed; the recipe's count is servings; with DT349 in one release, 0.3.193

DT349.title: The recipe page: the recipe as written on top, Servings and Foods, and What do you do with it? (Plan it, Put it on the Plate)

opportunity.from: Coach Milan 24 November 2026, 07:42, looking at the board B168; 13:44 to 14:50, brainstorm on the header and the portions. 25 November 07:54 to 08:02, looking at the board on his phone: the card and Cook for are not in sync; the structure of the page.
opportunity.job: Understand a recipe as it is written, then decide what to do with it.
opportunity.kind: Did not find it or did not understand it: the recipe's PD card looks different from the Plate's; Cook it looks like a button and sits by the numbers, which it does not change.
opportunity.why_now: B168 makes the card count a chosen number of portions, so the card and the cooking need their own places.

DT349.problem: The recipe page's PD card has its own layout: one small line for kcal, protein and grams, its numbers inside the card. On the Plate the same card has rows and opens its numbers under it. Cook it, under the card, looks like a call to action and says 1 portions. Drawn on 24 November, the card said All 4 servings while Cook for below could say 1 or 10: two counts on one page, not in sync. And Cook for 4 sounds like four people, who do not eat the same amount.
DT349.story: When I open a recipe, I want to read it as it is written and then decide what to do with it, so that my own amount is calculated where I have picked a day and a meal.
DT349.now: Recipe page: title, a No photo yet card with two buttons, the PD card (own layout: one small line, numbers inside), a Cook it card with − 4 portions + that looks like a button and says 1 portions, Foods, Nutrition, Steps with Start cooking.
DT349.proposed: The page is for reading and deciding (08:37 to 08:42). 1. The top is the recipe as written, fixed: title, photo, the PD card for the whole recipe, and further down the Nutrition table. 2. No photo yet: a placeholder picture of a meal in the photo's place, with No photo yet, Let Chef Mealan draw one and Add my photo on it. 3. The PD card is the Plate's card, one component (PdCard), with a short title; the numbers open under the card. The words against my target (0.5 under your 4.8) have their own line, the full width of the card, under the PD and its rows, on the Plate too (13:06). 4. Servings, the one choice on the page: chips 1 to 5 (and the recipe's or the plan's number when it is another), only numbers, each one tap; under them − and + for an exact number, always there, grey until used (13:06); saved with the recipe. One line gives the numbers for the choice: 2 servings: 1,097 kcal · 449 g · 47 g protein · PD 4.3. 5. Foods is one block, only the list, named for the choice (Foods for 2 servings). The Cook it card and the words Cook for go. 6. What do you do with it?, at the end of the page: Plan it (new) and Put it on the Plate (it was Change it first). Plan it opens the Plate's day and meal block in place; with a day and a meal picked it shows my portion for that meal (grams, kcal, protein; the PD is the recipe's) and Put it in the plan. Start cooking stays at the steps. On a recipe from someone else the third action is Save to My recipes. Just looking is the page's state, not a button. 7. My portion is calculated from that meal's size on that day (nutrition rules N11 and N17), capped at the whole recipe. Nothing about the author's goal is shown. 8. docs/rules/design.md D8: every PD card is PdCard and opens its numbers under it; design-rules.cjs checks it. DT351 is merged into this ticket as Plan it.
DT349.looked_at: Only − and +: not chosen; three taps from 4 to 1, every time. Only chips: not chosen, 17:38: an exact number is needed too (Other). The portions to cook above the PD card (14:00): not chosen, the header is the meal. The portions at Start cooking: not chosen, far from the foods they change. Each person's own portion (a father, a mother, a kid of 10, a kid of 3): later, its own ticket, DT350 (17:38). A food's PD card (FoodCard): not in DT349, unless Coach Milan says. Cook for as the label (24 November): not chosen, 25 November 08:01: it hides whose amounts these are; Servings and Portions say it. One selection that also moves the PD card (07:54): not chosen, the top is fixed. The meal choice as a later ticket (DT351): merged here, 08:02. See it as, meal chips for today on the recipe page (08:02): not chosen, 08:31 and 08:34: not what was asked; a meal makes no sense without the day. Just looking as a choice (08:34): not chosen, it is the page's state. The words as written and the plan on the chips: not chosen, 08:31. An Other chip that opens − and + (24 November): not chosen, 25 November 13:06: no need to activate the clicking. The words against the target beside the PD, as on the Plate until now: not chosen, 13:06: a long line there is a mess.
DT349.short: The recipe page: the recipe as written on top (PdCard, D8, a placeholder photo), Servings and Foods, What do you do with it? (Plan it with my portion, Put it on the Plate); DT351 merged in; with B168, 0.3.193

details: src/components/PdCard.tsx: title, pd, fit, line, kcal, grams, protein, scale, letters. The line is p.pd-line, under readout-mid. JourneyScreen's readout and NutritionCard use it; the caller draws the numbers under it. Walkthroughs that read the Plate's words against the target follow the new place.

RecipePage: the No photo yet card becomes rq-nopic-ph, a 4 by 3 placeholder picture (one drawn plate, no photo of a real dish) with the text and buttons on it. The Cook it section goes. New card rq-howmuch above Foods: the chips, the rq-cook-row always under them (class idle until − or + is used), the line rq-choice-line; setCook as now. New card rq-actions in the place of Change it first: Plan it opens plateCal (mode plan) in place, then the portion line and Put it in the plan (p.fill with the foods at my share).
mealSizeOn in src/components/Members.tsx: the size of one meal on one day by mealShare (N11). My portion is the meal's energy over the recipe's, capped at 1, times the foods.
To settle in the build: a slot that already holds a meal (ask before replacing, as Plan does); a day with no numbers (Plan it is not shown).
A member's recipe has its own page (MemberPage), which today shows your portion for the meal ahead at once, with Make it and Keep in mine. Not drawn here; asked.
